passages.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. A song.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David wrote it as a song.
David wrote it for the choirmaster.

passages.text: Praise awaits You, O God, in Zion; to You our vows will be fulfilled.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm as a song.
He gave it to the choirmaster.
God, You are in Zion.
People wait to praise You there.
You are God.
People will fulfill their vows to You.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָוִ֥ד שִֽׁיר׃ לְךָ֤ דֻֽמִיָּ֬ה תְהִלָּ֓ה אֱלֹ֘הִ֥ים בְּצִיּ֑וֹן וּ֝לְךָ֗ יְשֻׁלַּם־ נֶֽדֶר׃

passages.text: O You who listen to prayer, all people will come to You.
passages.sermon: God listens to prayer.\r\nAll people will come to God.
passages.original: שֹׁמֵ֥עַ תְּפִלָּ֑ה עָ֝דֶ֗יךָ כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֥ר יָבֹֽאוּ׃

passages.text: When iniquities prevail against me, You atone for our transgressions.
passages.sermon:
God is the one who forgives sins.
Sometimes, sins overwhelm me.
Our wrongdoings become too strong for us.
You, God, remove our sins.
You atone for all our transgressions.
passages.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י עֲ֭וֺנֹת גָּ֣בְרוּ מֶ֑נִּי פְּ֝שָׁעֵ֗ינוּ אַתָּ֥ה תְכַפְּרֵֽם׃

passages.text: Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.
passages.sermon:
God chooses certain people.
God brings these people close to Him.
These people live in God’s courts.
These people are blessed.
God’s house is good.
We are satisfied with the goodness in God’s house.
God’s temple is holy.
We are filled with the holiness of God’s temple.
passages.original: אַשְׁרֵ֤י׀ תִּֽבְחַ֣ר וּתְקָרֵב֮ יִשְׁכֹּ֪ן חֲצֵ֫רֶ֥יךָ נִ֭שְׂבְּעָה בְּט֣וּב בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ הֵיכָלֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.
passages.sermon:
God saves us.
God answers us.
God acts with awesome deeds.
God acts with righteousness.
God is the hope of all people.
People at the ends of the earth hope in God.
People on the farthest seas hope in God.
passages.original: נ֤וֹרָא֨וֹת׀ בְּצֶ֣דֶק תַּ֭עֲנֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ מִבְטָ֥ח כָּל־ קַצְוֵי־ אֶ֝֗רֶץ וְיָ֣ם רְחֹקִֽים׃

passages.text: You formed the mountains by Your power, having girded Yourself with might.
passages.sermon:
God formed the mountains.
God used His power to make the mountains.
God is strong.
God surrounds Himself with might.

passages.text: You stilled the roaring of the seas, the pounding of their waves, and the tumult of the nations.
passages.sermon:
God acts with great power.
God calms the loud noise of the seas.
God quiets the crashing of the waves.
God brings peace to the nations when they are in turmoil.
passages.original: מַשְׁבִּ֤יחַ׀ שְׁא֣וֹן יַ֭מִּים שְׁא֥וֹן גַּלֵּיהֶ֗ם וַהֲמ֥וֹן לְאֻמִּֽים׃

passages.text: Those who live far away fear Your wonders; You make the dawn and sunset shout for joy.
passages.sermon:
God performs wonders.
People who live far away see these wonders.
These people fear God’s power.
God makes the dawn joyful.
God makes the sunset joyful.
passages.original: וַיִּ֤ירְא֨וּ׀ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י קְ֭צָוֺת מֵאוֹתֹתֶ֑יךָ מ֤וֹצָֽאֵי־ בֹ֖קֶר וָעֶ֣רֶב תַּרְנִֽין׃

passages.text: You attend to the earth and water it; with abundance You enrich it. The streams of God are full of water, for You prepare our grain by providing for the earth.
passages.sermon:
God cares for the earth.
God gives water to the earth.
God makes the earth rich with plenty.
God’s streams are full of water.
God prepares grain for people.
God provides for the earth so people have food.
passages.original: פָּקַ֥דְתָּ הָאָ֨רֶץ׀ וַתְּשֹׁ֪קְקֶ֡הָ רַבַּ֬ת תַּעְשְׁרֶ֗נָּה פֶּ֣לֶג אֱ֭לֹהִים מָ֣לֵא מָ֑יִם תָּכִ֥ין דְּ֝גָנָ֗ם כִּי־ כֵ֥ן תְּכִינֶֽהָ׃

passages.text: You soak its furrows and level its ridges; You soften it with showers and bless its growth.
passages.sermon:
God cares for the earth.
God soaks the earth’s furrows with water.
God makes the ridges of the earth level.
God sends showers to soften the earth.
God blesses the earth’s growth.
passages.original: תְּלָמֶ֣יהָ רַ֭וֵּה נַחֵ֣ת גְּדוּדֶ֑יהָ בִּרְבִיבִ֥ים תְּ֝מֹגְגֶ֗נָּה צִמְחָ֥הּ תְּבָרֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: You crown the year with Your bounty, and Your paths overflow with plenty.
passages.sermon:
God gives good things.
God fills the year with His blessings.
God’s ways bring abundance.
God’s paths overflow with plenty.
passages.original: עִ֭טַּרְתָּ שְׁנַ֣ת טוֹבָתֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מַעְגָּלֶ֗יךָ יִרְעֲפ֥וּן דָּֽשֶׁן׃

passages.text: The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are robed with joy.
passages.sermon: God blesses the land.\r\nThe pastures in the wilderness overflow.\r\nThe hills wear joy like a robe.
passages.original: יִ֭רְעֲפוּ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר וְ֝גִ֗יל גְּבָע֥וֹת תַּחְגֹּֽרְנָה׃

passages.text: The pastures are clothed with flocks, and the valleys are decked with grain. They shout in triumph; indeed, they sing.
passages.sermon:
God gives good things to the land.
The pastures are full of sheep.
The valleys are covered with grain.
The land shouts with joy.
The land sings.
passages.original: לָבְשׁ֬וּ כָרִ֨ים׀ הַצֹּ֗אן וַעֲמָקִ֥ים יַֽעַטְפוּ־ בָ֑ר יִ֝תְרוֹעֲע֗וּ אַף־ יָשִֽׁירוּ׃
